title: doe-testbed: Physics-grounded engineering test problems and benchmark for DOE method evaluation
description: A Python library of 34 physics-grounded engineering test problems (cantilever beam, airfoil stall, fin heat sink, ten-bar truss, ...) under a unified BaseCase interface, plus a standardised benchmark suite that compares the frozen 20-method nature_pool() DOE / surrogate / Bayesian-optimisation headline set on these cases. Includes per-(case, method, repeat) seed derivation, Holm-Bonferroni-corrected pairwise tests, Cliff's delta with bootstrap CIs, sensitivity recovery, sample-complexity analysis (n*/d per topology), failure-probability bias quantification, and a bilingual web dashboard. This deposit accompanies the manuscript 'Benchmarking design-of-experiments guidance in physics-grounded engineering simulations' (prepared for Communications Engineering).
